name: Sync Word Detection - Nominal
description: Verifies 0x1ACFFC1D sync marker matches satellite frame start.

name: Sync Word Detection - Corrupted Byte
description: Rejects packet with 0x1ACF001D invalid sync word.

name: CRC-CCITT Verification - Nominal Frame 0x0001
description: Calculates CRC16 using polynomial 0x1021 on 16-byte telemetry frame.

name: CRC-CCITT Verification - Altitude Frame 0x0002
description: Validates second frame CRC remainder 0x29B1 against lookup table 0x00402010.

name: CRC-CCITT Verification - Bit Flip Detection
description: Detects 1-bit corrupted packet at byte offset 9 and rejects packet.

name: Sensor Calibration - Orbital Altitude (Perigee)
description: Decodes raw altitude integer 0x000662A0 to 418.5 km using polynomial matrix 0x00402090.

name: Sensor Calibration - Orbital Altitude (Apogee)
description: Decodes raw altitude integer 0x00067340 to 423.2 km.

name: Sensor Calibration - Battery Bus Voltage (Nominal)
description: Converts 12-bit ADC voltage reading 0x0C30 to 28.4V regulated bus.

name: Sensor Calibration - Battery Bus Voltage (Low Warning)
description: Converts 0x0A80 to 24.2V low bus state and verifies flag.

name: Sensor Calibration - Solar Array Thermal (Sunlight)
description: Decodes thermistor reading to +68.4 C in orbital daylight.

name: Sensor Calibration - Solar Array Thermal (Eclipse)
description: Decodes thermistor reading to -42.1 C during Earth occultation.

name: Downlink Stream Parser - 48-byte Stream Framing
description: Unpacks full CCSDS telemetry packet into TelemetryPacket C struct.

name: Downlink Stream Parser - Sub-packet Truncation
description: Handles truncated stream (<48 bytes) gracefully with return code -1.

name: Downlink Stream Parser - End-to-End Mission Nominal
description: Decodes complete 5-second orbital telemetry frame burst with 0 errors.

name: Downlink Stream Parser - Multi-Frame Reordering
description: Validates sequence counter increment from 0x010A to 0x010B.
